headline: Fisherman's Row, Linn of Mercy Go Wholly Colonial as Toll Mounts
war_summary: Three hours further into the night, the Colonial column has widened its lead. Fisherman's Row, divided at our last writing, is now wholly Colonial, its last Warden works taken in the small hours, and the Linn of Mercy shows all eleven works under Colonial colors, its ruined work rebuilt. A lone Colonial capture at The Wind Hills has broken into Mooring County's Warden-held ground, leaving that region at eleven works to one. Callahan's Passage remains the bloodiest field: 10,300 Colonial against 7,800 Warden casualties in the day's count, losses above 300 an hour on either side, the two-hour pace cooling from the surge before it. The Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, quiet these two hours, logged 45 and 47 base actions across the day, their lines unchanged at six Warden works to three. Stonecradle has seen no base action since just after midnight, yet its casualty rate climbs, 4,750 against 5,600. Marban Hollow stirs anew, its recent losses and enlistments on the rise, though no base has changed hands there. All fronts together count some 38,500 Colonial and 43,800 Warden losses in the day. The ledger stands at 297 Colonial works to 139 Warden, none in ruin, a net shift of five since our last edition. No victor is declared on Day 230 of the war.
